decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [PROJ/3227/100, PROJ/3227/101, PROJ/3227/102, PROJ/3227/103, PROJ/3227/104, PROJ/3227/105, PROJ/3227/106, unnumbered location plan. Received: 25/11/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - The ground floor premises shall be used for Use Class E(a) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), nor in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension with a rear roller shutter to the shop, and erection of a rear roof extension with two front roof windows to the flat.
